counting_rule: For each of 114 distinct package identities, count only inventory records marked machine=AArch64 and abi=arm64-v8a. Count each ELF DT_NEEDED relation once and distinct ELF bytes by SHA256. Split-member receipts replace aggregate placeholders. This snapshot has 1226 such ELF records; the checkpoint's 1762 is a separately maintained cumulative static metric and is not substituted for this deduplicated denominator.

hypothesis.candidate: A complete platform ARM64 Bionic liblog provider with install placement and required exports could satisfy one shared native dependency edge for 78 accepted APK identities.
hypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: Inspect a same-generation product liblog.so and install manifest first. If already present, correctly typed, installed and export-complete, provider absence is false; advance to actual loader evidence rather than rebuilding.

limits: DT_NEEDED is a static declaration and does not prove that the library is loaded on a cold-start path.
Zero same-APK ARM64 providers does not prove that the current Android product lacks liblog.so.
A successful liblog build or install mapping cannot alone show any of the 78 APKs start; other dependencies may fail first.
No device, container, SSH, remote, Bridge, canonical state or count mutation was performed.

steps: Read-only anti-join: inspect same-generation product installed-file manifest and ARM64 liblog.so ELF, recording exact path, SHA256, SONAME, machine and exported dynamic symbols. If complete, stop without a rebuild.

If absent or incomplete, use the original owner's fresh native Soong build route with only the liblog module target and recorded argv/rc/OUT/TMP/source guards; do not select the ndk_library stub or liblog_for_runtime_apex static variant as runtime artifact.

After rc0, bind produced ELF SHA256, AArch64 machine, SONAME liblog.so, dynamic exports and installed-file manifest to the same build generation. Compare required liblog dynamic symbols for the 807 consumer ELFs. Retain compiler/linker errors exactly if rc != 0.

observed_wall: none for liblog on a current-generation Android Bionic loader. The current checkpoint records no authenticated exact-R4 native Linux Soong graph or target artifact; absence of that receipt is a provenance gap, not an observed missing-library failure.
scope: Read-only distinct-package cross-APK DT_NEEDED ranking of the current 114 root-admitted raw/host-static package identities; no loader or device experiment.
selection: liblog.so is the highest-ranked one-module provider after the Bionic libc/libdl/libm bootstrap trio, covering 78 distinct accepted APKs and 807 ARM64 ELF DT_NEEDED edges. Exact R4 source defines a platform shared module. One same-generation product artifact/install audit can falsify a provider gap; libz.so is the next narrower dependency candidate (26 packages/161 edges). This ranking is static leverage, not runtime unblocking.
